title: Development and validation of a machine learning-based diagnostic system for 22 pediatric respiratory pathogens: a large-scale multicenter study.
summary: A machine-learning diagnostic system distinguished among 22 pediatric respiratory pathogens in multicenter derivation and validation cohorts. The reported cohort validation does not establish improved patient outcomes.
ai_technology: A machine-learning diagnostic system classifies test results among 22 pediatric respiratory pathogens.
organization: Institute for Clinical Medical Research, the First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University, School of Medicine, Xiamen University, Xiamen, Fujian, China; Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital Center of Molecular Diagnostic and Therapy, State Key Laboratory of Pharmaceutical Biotechnology, Jiangsu Engineering Research Center for MicroRNA Biology and Biotechnology, NJU Advanced Institute of Life Sciences (NAILS), School of Life Sciences, Nanjing University, Nanjing, Jiangsu, China

evidence.tested: Multicenter derivation and validation cohorts; prospective impact on treatment or patient outcomes was not established.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study
evidence.ai_role: A machine-learning diagnostic system classifies test results among 22 pediatric respiratory pathogens.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
